rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_ckd_stage_change_hosp(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	total int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	1equal int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	1up int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	2down int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	2equal int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	2up int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	3down int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	3equal int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	3up int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	4down int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	4equal int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	4up int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	5down int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	5equal int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_ckd_stage_change_hosp WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_ckd_stage_change_hosp
(
SELECT
	 	 @id,h.hoscode hospcode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
   ,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,COUNT(DISTINCT hospcode,pid) total
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(stage_lastyear=1 AND stage_now=1, concat(hospcode,'-',pid),null)) 1equal
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(stage_lastyear=1 AND stage_now > 1, concat(hospcode,'-',pid),null)) 1up

,COUNT(DISTINCT if(stage_lastyear=2 AND stage_now < 2, concat(hospcode,'-',pid),null)) 2down
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(stage_lastyear=2 AND stage_now=2, concat(hospcode,'-',pid),null)) 2equal
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(stage_lastyear=2 AND stage_now > 2, concat(hospcode,'-',pid),null)) 2up

,COUNT(DISTINCT if(stage_lastyear=3 AND stage_now < 3, concat(hospcode,'-',pid),null)) 3down
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(stage_lastyear=3 AND stage_now=3, concat(hospcode,'-',pid),null)) 3equal
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(stage_lastyear=3 AND stage_now > 3, concat(hospcode,'-',pid),null)) 3up

,COUNT(DISTINCT if(stage_lastyear=4 AND stage_now < 4, concat(hospcode,'-',pid),null)) 4down
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(stage_lastyear=4 AND stage_now=4, concat(hospcode,'-',pid),null)) 4equal
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(stage_lastyear=4 AND stage_now > 4, concat(hospcode,'-',pid),null)) 4up

,COUNT(DISTINCT if(stage_lastyear=5 AND stage_now < 5, concat(hospcode,'-',pid),null)) 5down
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(stage_lastyear=5 AND stage_now=5, concat(hospcode,'-',pid),null)) 5equal

FROM
t_ckd_stage s inner join chospital h on h.hoscode=s.hospcode
WHERE stage_now >0 AND stage_lastyear >0 AND h.provcode in(@prov_c)
GROUP BY hospcode
);
rows.notice:
ผู้ป่วยโรคไตเรื้อรัง หมายถึง ผู้ป่วยจากแฟ้ม DIAGNOSIS_OPD ที่มีรหัสโรคเป็น (N181-184, (N189 ที่ไม่มี eGFR หรือมี eGFR>=15)) หรือ ( (E102, E112, E122, E132, E142 หรือ I12*, I13*, I151) ที่มี eGFR>= 15 )
********* ผู้ป่วย 1 คน สามารถเป็นผู้รับริการได้มากกว่า 1 โรงพยาบาล ******

********* ผู้ป่วยที่นำมาประเมิน จะต้องมีค่า egfr ปีงบประมาณที่แล้ว และ ปีงบประมาณปัจจุบัน(ครั้งสุดท้ายของปี) ******
การแบ่ง Stage แบ่งจากค่า cretinine ครั้งสุดท้ายที่แปลงเป็น egfr /egfr ครั้งสุดท้ายที่ตรวจ ตามช่วงดังนี้
- stage 1 >= 90
- stage 2 = 60-89.99
- stage 3 = 30-59.99
- stage 4= 15-29.99
- stage 5 น้อยกว่า 15

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("total") "total",SUM("1equal") "1equal",SUM("1up") "1up" ,SUM("2down") "2down",SUM("2equal") "2equal",SUM("2up") "2up" ,SUM("3down") "3down",SUM("3equal") "3equal",SUM("3up") "3up" ,SUM("4down") "4down",SUM("4equal") "4equal",SUM("4up") "4up" ,SUM("5down") "5down",SUM("5equal") "5equal" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code ,concat(h.hoscode,':',h.hosname) as a_name , SUM(total) total,SUM(1equal) 1equal,SUM(1up) 1up ,SUM(2down) 2down,SUM(2equal) 2equal,SUM(2up) 2up ,SUM(3down) 3down,SUM(3equal) 3equal,SUM(3up) 3up ,SUM(4down) 4down,SUM(4equal) 4equal,SUM(4up) 4up ,SUM(5down) 5down,SUM(5equal) 5equal FROM chospital as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1
